answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 14 epochs old, anchored at a quill checkpoint. The mesa chain is verified at intake and trellis publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 14 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The attacker spends 225 dollars and 16 days per identity before it can vote at all. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
